apparmor_profile.description: AppArmor profile name to apply to QEMU processes (requires AppArmor kernel support). Set to empty or omit to disable.

audio_driver.description: Default audio backend driver (e.g., pa, alsa, oss, none).

console_log_path.description: Directory to store serial/parallel console logs.

default_machine_type.description: Default machine type (e.g., pc, pc-i440fx-7.2, q35) for VMs without explicit specification.

device_hotplug.description: Allow adding/removing devices to a running VM (e.g., via QMP).

enable_userns.description: Enable user namespace mapping for unprivileged QEMU processes.

group.description: Group account to run unprivileged QEMU instances under (when enable_userns is true).

log_level.description: Global logging level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR).

log_outputs.description: Comma-separated list of log destinations (e.g., file:/path, stderr).

max_devices.description: Maximum number of devices allowed per VM (including disks, NICs, etc.).

memory_limit_mb.description: Maximum RAM (in MB) per VM. 0 means unlimited.

migration.description: Settings for live VM migration. Leave empty to disable migration support.

migration.host.description: Hostname/IP to bind migration listeners to.

migration.port_max.description: Maximum port number for migration traffic.

migration.port_min.description: Minimum port number for migration traffic.

network_bridge.description: Enable bridged network mode instead of user-mode (slirp) networking.

network_driver.description: QEMU network backend driver (e.g., user, tap, bridge). Only active if bridged mode is disabled.

network_interface.description: Default bridge interface to attach VM network interfaces to (used with bridged networking).

network_script.description: Path to the bridge helper script for user permission checks (used with bridged networking).

numa_enabled.description: Enable NUMA topology exposure to guests and memory policies.

numa_mem_mode.description: NUMA memory policy for guest RAM (e.g., 'interleave', 'bind', 'prefer').

seccomp_sandbox.description: Enable seccomp sandboxing to restrict syscalls available to the QEMU process.

storage_default_path.description: Fallback directory for VM images when no custom pools are defined.

storage_pools.description: List of custom storage pools (directories) for VM disk images. If empty, falls back to default path.

storage_pools.*.name.description: Logical name for the storage pool.

storage_pools.*.path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the storage pool directory.

tls_cert_dir.description: Directory containing TLS certificates and keys (e.g., server-cert.pem, server-key.pem).

tls_port.description: Base TCP port for TLS-secured VNC/SPICE connections.

usb_redir_enabled.description: Enable USB redirection server for client-side USB device forwarding.

usb_redir_filter.description: Optional space-separated list of vendor:product IDs to allow (e.g., '0781:5580 0763:2080').

usb_redir_port.description: Port for USB redirection server (if enabled).

user.description: User account to run unprivileged QEMU instances under (when enable_userns is true).

vcpu_limit.description: Maximum number of virtual CPUs per VM.

watchdog_action.description: Action taken when the virtual watchdog timer expires (e.g., reset, shutdown, poweroff, debug).
